acceptanceCriteria: A test runs a worker that writes past the cap and proves the log stays within the stated bound.
Finished worker directories are removed or bounded, stated in the leases spec.
body:
Observed 2026-10-07 by a read-only cleanup audit of the orchestrator session (code at batch 4 head 5808c26c; installed corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202). Owner goal: keep Corvint lean and efficient on disk and CPU.

Suspected defect, confirmed in code but not observed on disk (no dispatcher state existed). <state>/<program>/workers/<id>/stdout.log and stderr.log are opened for append with no size cap (internal/tasks/dispatch/process_unix.go:75). Nothing in the dispatcher removes worker directories; its only removals are unpark requests and the ledger temp file.

Expected: per-worker output capped (like detached runs, 2x8 MiB) and finished worker directories retired within a bound.
Actual: unbounded append, never pruned.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#649 (rc3 cleanup), merged to main 2026-10-07T13:49:36Z as ce6313a015bf94d1dc675eb2130b2c2c3851c65a. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0930-dispatch-worker-log-bound.md, docs/decisions/0440-rc3-cleanup-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/48c959dbb62e0cc79ed4c81cc90a524920827e0f.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0440 records the owner's acceptance of CAL-V0-143 and CAL-V0-144. The batch passed focused package tests, go vet on darwin/linux/windows, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal, and every hosted CI check on the merge head. NOT_RUN: make gate, the live macOS update lifecycle, Linux dispatcher runtime and live dispatcher qualification. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.

title: Suspected: dispatcher worker stdout/stderr logs grow without bound and worker directories are never removed
